messages:
anna-cs: Escalation from SecureForms — they report a new token-like string appearing in generated responses since yesterday's rollout. Customer says it breaks their post-processing parser. Asked them to share examples and logs. (Ticket #14782)

anna-cs: Customer sample pasted below from their support email:
```
User: summarize order #8421 for shipping
Model: Order summary:\n- Item: Laptop\n- Price: $1,299.00\n- Shipping: Standard\n- Order ID: 8421\n- Trace: <TRACE:7f4c-9a1b>\nThank you for shopping with us!
```
They say the `<TRACE:...>` bits weren't present before the deploy and now every summary sometimes contains one.

olivia-devex: :eyes: Can you please request the customer's prompt logs and a minimal repro? Give them the exact steps. If they can't share full logs, ask for the raw request payload + model name + route id + response id for one example.

olivia-devex: Suggested copy for customer message:
"Hi — thanks for reporting. Could you paste one full request/response pair (redact any PII) and tell us the model name, temperature, max_tokens, and the route id or tenant id used? If you can, please also run the minimal repro below and paste its response. That will help us triage faster."

anna-cs: I sent that to the customer and asked for a minimal repro within 24h. I also asked whether they're on Dedicated or Hosted. They use Hosted.

mike-ml: Thanks — from ML side, please include the model variant and exact timestamp of the failing requests. Also capture the raw tokens around the insertion. If they can share the request_id(s) we can fetch prompt logs from the retention store.

jess-eng: Quick checklist for the customer to reproduce locally / for us to triage:
- Model: (exact name e.g., redwood-open-7b-instruct)
- Parameters: temperature, top_p, max_tokens, stop sequences
- Example prompt (paste verbatim)
- Any pre/post-processing (strip whitespace, run through HTML escape)
- Whether prefix caching or KV cache is enabled

jess-eng: If you want a minimal repro template for them, use this curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "<MODEL_NAME>",
    "input": "Summarize order #8421 for shipping",
    "temperature": 0.0,
    "max_tokens": 200
  }'
```
Ask them to paste the full JSON response.

sam-platform: From infra: deploy-bot shows a prod rollout yesterday. If this is deterministic with that model binary, could be a stray debug injection during build or a logging wrapper leaking into output. I'll pull the rollout artifact and diff the inference-serving wrapper.

deploy-bot: rolled out redwood-open-7b-instruct v2.3.1 -> prod at 2234987600 (staging at 2234981120)

mike-ml: If customer can't share logs, request a single request_id from a failing call — we can use that to look up trace/narrow logs without them sharing full payloads.

olivia-devex: Also asked customer whether they use automatic post-processing that strips or transforms tokens; sometimes double-escaping or a preprocessor can surface tags.

anna-cs: Customer replied that they'll try the repro curl and share the JSON response + one request_id. I flagged P2 and added the ticket link. Assigning follow-ups: @mike-ml to look at model outputs, @jess-eng to check serving wrapper, @sam-platform to check rollout artifacts. I'll update thread when customer posts logs. :rocket:

mike-ml: I'll start by grepping model tokenizer/byte-pair merges for '<TRACE' and run a small sweep of last 24h inference logs for literal '<TRACE:'.

jess-eng: If it turns out a logging macro got compiled in, we need an emergency rollback plan. Keep me posted. :thinking_face:

anna-cs: Thanks team — holding until customer posts the repro. Ticket 14782 updated with this thread and assigned.
